value.rationale: Area-halving distances h_A and H_A are established natural invariants in the 2007 general convex-body work. Their exact sharp values for the entire infinite odd-regular-polygon class, equality directions, and full nontrivial angular profile give a useful benchmark for general convex-body inequalities and clarify the difference between actual area bisectors and ordinary central chords. This is not merely a finite example or routine substitution.
